title: What is “Magical Mormon Mystery Week” at Book of Mormon and is it wor...
transcript: So what the heck is going on at book of Mormon right now? They are currently doing something called Magical Mormon Mystery Week, but based on the marketing it was kind of unclear to me exactly what that entailed. I knew it had something to do with original cast members from the show coming back, but exactly what kind of role they would be playing in the show was unclear to me, so I went to find out for myself. I paid $99 for a standing room seat, which insane, but this is basically what I found out. The only people guaranteed to be at each performance are Josh Gad, Andrew Rannells, Nicki M James, and Rory O'malley. Sadly, it does not seem like we will be getting any appearances from Michael Potts or Brian Tyree Henry. But it is cool to have the core 4 as it were, back, even if it's in a limited capacity. And I say limited capacity because they are not performing the entire role. Instead, most of the show is being performed by the show's current cast, with the original company members tapping in for certain scenes or songs. So let me give you a rundown of all of the special appearances at my show. Although be aware that they do say no show will be exactly the same, so if you are going later this week you may get a slightly different assortment of scenes. My show started off with all of the Original Mormons coming out to do hello, including Josh, Andrew and Rory. Josh and Andrew then came back to do you and me, but mostly me, as well as a short scene with Nikki M James and turn it off with Rory O'malley. Then they all came back for a man up to close out the act, along with Michael James Scott to declare that he has maggots in his- Then in Act 2, Andrew did I believe, Josh and Nikki did baptize me. Then Josh and Andrew came back for one final scene, and it's that scene where Elder Price is drunk on caffeine. My performance also had an appearance from Trey Parker and Matt Stone, who created South Park as well as this show, with Trey Parker playing Joseph Smith and Matt Stone playing Jesus, which was very fun. They are set to appear at some, but not all of the performances, so, for example, I don't believe they were at Tuesday's show. Also set to appear at some point is Bobby Lopez, who wrote the music, but he didn't make an appearance at my show. And to be honest, I'm kind of mixed on this approach. It is obviously thrilling to see these original cast members return to these roles. Seeing Andrew do I believe, seeing Josh and Nikki do baptise me, it's electric. But I did find that when they were not on, that the audience was just kind of waiting for their next appearance. And I Kinda felt a little bit bad for the current cast, all of whom are really excellent, but it kind of detracts from their performance a little bit. But at the same time, I do recognize that it was probably impossible to get these four actors to come back and do their full tracks. So if this weird, Frankensteined together show is what it takes to get these performers back, then I do kind of think it was worth it. Even in just their few scenes together, their chemistry is still off the charts. They slip back into these roles so naturally that it really does feel like they never left.
